coastal.title: B.C. man who went missing in mountains for several days found alive
coastal.description: Stanislav Volo went for a hike on Sunday above the Sea-to-Sky Gondola and did not return home.

coastal.title: Vancouver police officer accused of defrauding 19 victims of $3M
coastal.description: Vancouver police say a high-profile officer who was arrested on Thursday allegedly defrauded 19 victims of a total of about $3 million.

coastal.title: Why Vancouver Island municipalities are maintaining campfire bans through the Labour Day long weekend
coastal.description: A number of municipalities in the Greater Victoria area are maintaining campfire bans through the Labour Day long weekend, even as campfire bans on areas outside municipal boundaries have lifted throughout B.C.

coastal.title: Cathedral Grove winner of The Search for B.C.'s Best Roadside Attraction
coastal.description: A controversial parking lot, adjacent logging and more than 100 years of interest make Cathedral Grove a site of competing values.

kamloops.title: After an intense summer of wildfires, Lytton River Festival aims to bring life to the community
kamloops.description: The Village of Lytton is hosting its annual festival this year, with a special emphasis on cultural history of Chinese people and the village's legacy.

kamloops.title: Critic calls on B.C. to salvage more wildfire-burned timber, province says that's 'unrealistic.' Here's why
kamloops.description: Kamloops-North Thompson MLA Ward Stamer is calling for the province’s salvage rate to rise to 25 per cent and for more efficient access to wildfire-damaged timber.

kamloops.title: Kamloops officials ask for public's help after man attacked by 2 dogs
kamloops.description: Eric Dean said he was walking along the riverside trail near his business, Kamloops Precision Machining in the Valleyview neighbourhood, around lunchtime on Wednesday when the attack happened.

prince-george.title: Northern B.C. community brings back dinosaur mascot from extinction, after a nearly 30-year 'sabbatical'
prince-george.description: The District of Hudson's Hope unveiled a new costume for the town's mascot, Dudley the Dinosaur, last week. Kelsey Shewfelt, the recreation co-ordinator for the district, says the public has been asking to see Dudley return for years.

prince-george.title: Brink Forest Products to cut 50 jobs at its Prince George lumber plant
prince-george.description: Brink Forest Products cuts roughly 50 jobs at its Prince George, B.C., plant as the company reduces operations to 20 per cent citing a lack of fibre and U.S. tariff costs, among factors.

prince-george.title: Province advances Old Fort landslide study in northeast B.C.
prince-george.description: Three separate landslides in the same spot since 2018 have prompted evacuations and destroyed a home and other critical infrastructure in the Old Fort community just south of Fort St John.
